title: Blueberry Kumis Smoothie
excerpt: Enjoy a super creamy drink with the traditional touch of our land. This smoothie combines the smoothness of kumis (Colombian fermented milk) with the natural sweetness of Fresh Pick blueberries.
imageAlt: A tall glass with a vibrant purple smoothie, topped with fresh blueberries, on a rustic wooden table.
steps: Wash the Fresh Pick blueberries carefully. Remember not to rub them hard so you keep their natural bloom, that whitish layer that protects them.
Put the blueberries in the blender with the two cups of very cold kumis.
Add the tablespoon of honey and the pinch of ground cinnamon for a delicious aromatic touch.
Blend on high speed for 1 to 2 minutes, until the mixture is completely smooth and takes on an intense violet tone.
If you prefer a colder, denser consistency, add the ice cubes and blend for 30 more seconds.
Serve immediately in cold glasses and top with a couple of whole blueberries.
tips: Our Fresh Pick blueberries are lovingly grown in the high mountains of Guasca, Cundinamarca; thanks to this and their natural sweetness of up to 15° Brix, you will notice you hardly need to add sweeteners to the recipe.
For a spectacular frappé-style texture, freeze the blueberries in an airtight bag the night before making the recipe.
